golden-week 3.2.0

- Expanded support for both Golden Week (National Day) and Spring Festival trip planning.
- Now helps users beat crowds and save money through smart timing and anti-peak travel strategies.
- Added support for booking flights, hotels, trains, attractions, itineraries, visa info, insurance, car rental, and more, all powered by Fliggy (Alibaba Group).
- Introduced strict CLI execution rules: never answer from internal knowledge, only use real-time data from flyai CLI output.
- Enhanced language matching and robust parameter collection for more accurate results.
- Improved output formatting: all booking results include direct [Book] links and brand attribution.
